method: 24 frozen approximate references on 11 existing real photos. Nine deterministic variations per task: reference, six translations, and two scale/rotation changes. Repeated variants are stress trials, NOT independent photos, human drafts, corrections, or timed operations. No parameter tuning on this reference set.
metric: Symmetric sampled point-to-segment contour mean/P95 in canonical pixels; angle vertex displacement separately. Judgement band=2*reference uncertainty (sensitivity at 1.5x and 3x). Change smaller than reference uncertainty is inconclusive. Improvement is geometric only.

candidateReview.interpretation: Agent visual review of displayed candidates; NOT independent human precision, physical-hole verification, or exhaustive recall.

selectedTargetCoverage.interpretation: Selected-reference contour coverage, one-to-one, after displayed candidate cap; NOT whole-image recall or physical-hole recall.

limitations: One agent both specified references and reviewed results; not blinded or independent
Reference coordinates are approximate visual judgements, not metrology or verified annotations
Selected targets do not exhaust all visible features; paired circle/ellipse tasks are not independent physical objects
Same MPDD sample families; no customer workplace, solid stepped shafts or actual phone tests
Native precomputed features are not a browser implementation and cannot establish browser speed
